name: fing-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the Fing Local API: device inventory, presence and network summary.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description:
Diagnose the connection to Fing: checks the Local API (/devices and /people)
and reads the agent's UPnP identity (Fingbox / Fing Agent only). Never fails —
each check reports ok or the error it hit.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description:
Look up a single device by MAC, IP or name.

Exact MAC / IP / name matches win; otherwise partial name matches are
returned. If the device has an owner and the agent is Fing Desktop, the
owner's display name is included as ``ownerName``.

identifier.description: MAC address (any separator), IP address, or device name (exact or partial)

tools.name: get_network_summary
tools.description:
Summarise the network: online/offline counts, breakdown by type and make,
devices with no name or make (possible unknowns), and the most recently
changed and newest devices.

top.description: How many recent / new devices to include

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description:
List devices discovered by the Fing agent, sorted by IP address.

Returns the network ID, the total device count, how many matched the
filters, and the matching devices with their MAC, IPs, state, name, type,
make, model, owner contactId and first_seen / last_changed timestamps.

state.description: Only devices that are online (UP) or offline (DOWN)

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against name, make, model, type, IP and MAC

device_type.description: Exact Fing device type, e.g. STREAMING_DONGLE, PHONE, LIGHT

changed_within_hours.description: Only devices whose state changed in the last N hours

new_within_hours.description: Only devices first seen in the last N hours

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List people (Fing contacts) and their presence. Requires Fing Desktop as the agent.

state.description: Only people currently ONLINE or OFFLINE

include_pictures.description: Include base64 avatar image data (large; off by default)
